decisive_items: new discordant ST elevation of 1mm in leads II, III, and aVF
thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft proximal to circumflex anastomosis
new reciprocal ST depression <1mm in aVL
response.rationale: The ECG shows new ST elevation in inferior leads with reciprocal changes, and catheterization confirms thrombotic graft occlusion, consistent with acute myocardial infarction. The negative troponin is early and does not exclude MI.

rejected.why: No history of cardiac transplantation; allograft vasculopathy is not applicable.
Graft occlusion is the underlying cause but not the clinical diagnosis; MI is the appropriate syndrome.
ACS is broader and less specific; MI is the precise diagnosis given ST elevation and confirmed occlusion.
